title: WeakRef Signal Dispatcher Pattern with Dead-Receiver Garbage Collection

claims.assertion: Event bus subscriber registries must wrap receiver callables in weak references and execute automated dead-reference pruning during dispatch to avoid unbounded memory leaks in long-running agent processes

context: Long-running daemon processes, agent sessions, and server frameworks that dynamically connect event handlers accumulate stale subscriber references when objects are destroyed, leading to silent memory bloat and ghost invocations.
